title: Lens
description: A projection of the same facts into a different mental model. Maps every stage to zones, with capability-level overrides only where the stage default is wrong. Structural rules only; the validator checks that every stage is mapped and every override resolves.

defaults.description: Stage id -> where that stage's capabilities land. Every stage must appear. Band cells are placed by the stage they are scored at.

overrides.description: Exceptions where the stage default is wrong. Most specific match wins: an exact capability ID beats a <stage-or-band>.* pattern, which beats the stage default.

unmapped.description: What happens to anything placed as 'unmapped'. drop removes it from the view; rail shows it in a side rail so a gap never silently vanishes.

match.description: An exact capability ID, or <stage-or-band>.* for every capability under it.

placement.description: A list of zone ids, 'all' for every zone, or 'unmapped' when this lens has no honest home for it.
